description: This line plot illustrates performance with different chunking sizes across four data sources. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and uses a linear scale ranging from 200 to 800, with tick marks at regular intervals of 200. The y-axis lacks a specific text label but represents performance values on a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. Four solid lines with circular markers represent the different data sources. The blue line, representing "Tutorials," starts at approximately 17 at 200 tokens, rises to a peak of roughly 31 at 600 tokens, and declines to about 29 at 800 tokens. The red line, representing "Library Documentation," begins near 24 at 200 tokens, increases to a peak of approximately 33 at 600 tokens, and drops to roughly 29 at 800 tokens. The yellow line, representing "StackOverflow posts," shows a steady decline across the entire x-axis, starting at its highest point of approximately 28 at 200 tokens, dropping to roughly 21 at 600 tokens, and ending at approximately 13 at 800 tokens. The green line, representing "GitHub files," starts near 24 at 200 tokens, rises to a peak of about 30 at 600 tokens, and slightly decreases to approximately 29 at 800 tokens.
